fc.ibfai_indicazioni_generali_ph: E.g.: answers as a "description - code" list; no introductions; examples in C++. They apply both to choosing the concepts and to writing the cards, and they're remembered.
fc.ibfai_documento_lungo: Long document ({car} characters): I'll read it in {blocchi} parts, in the background. You can follow the progress and review the concept list before the cards are written.
fc.ibfai_densita_doc_lungo: "More concepts" isn't available on a document this long: add them to the list by hand.
fc.ibfai_densita_troppi: "Fewer concepts" works up to {n} items: merge the others by hand with the merge button.
fc.ibfai_err_rete: No connection, or an unstable one. Check your network and try again.
fc.ibfai_err_quota: Too many AI requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
fc.ibfai_err_sovraccarico: The AI servers are overloaded. I've already retried: wait a few seconds and try again.
fc.ibfai_err_lento: The AI was taking too long, so I stopped it before it could break off. Try again: the second attempt is usually much faster.
fc.ibfai_err_filtro: The AI refused to answer on this content. Try rephrasing or regenerating.
fc.ibfai_err_troncata: The answer was too long to send in one go. Try again with fewer concepts at a time.
fc.ibfai_err_nostro: There's a configuration problem on our side, not yours. You haven't been charged anything.
fc.ibfai_job_ripreso: I picked up the generation where it left off.
fc.ibfai_job_nota_chiudi: You can minimise this window and keep working on the cards that have already arrived. If you close the page, generation pauses and resumes when you reopen this deck.
fc.ibfai_job_in_attesa: The server is handling other requests: I'll carry on in a few seconds.
fc.ibfai_job_rete_instabile: The connection is unstable: the work done so far is safe, I'm retrying.
fc.ibfai_job_altrove: Generation in progress on “{nome}” — tap to open it
fc.ibfai_job_revisione: I found {n} concepts. Review them, remove the ones you don't need, then press "Generate flashcards".
fc.ibfai_job_crediti_finiti_tit: Out of credits for this month
fc.ibfai_job_crediti_finiti: I generated {fatte} cards, and they stay in the deck. The work is paused: it will pick up where it stopped once you have credits again.
fc.ibfai_job_avviso_crediti: Heads up: the estimate is higher than the credits you have left this month. I'm starting anyway: if they run out I'll stop, and the cards already made will stay.
fc.ibfai_job_sospeso: Something is wrong on our side, so I stopped the work rather than waste time. You haven't been charged for the failed attempts. You can resume in a few minutes.
fc.ibfai_job_finito_scoperti: I generated {fatte} cards, but some concepts were left without one. I can retry just those: the cards already made won't be touched.
fc.ibfai_job_fallito: None of the steps succeeded. You haven't been charged anything. You can try again.
fc.ibfai_job_gia_attivo: A generation is already running. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it, before starting another.
fc.ibfai_job_annulla_testo: The cards already generated stay in the deck. The missing ones won't be created, and you won't be charged for them.
